sentences.text: 2. Heard Mr. Devansh Kakkad, learned counsel for and on behalf of the applicant.

Though served,
none has appeared for and on behalf of the respondent-husband.

3. Facts and circumstances giving rise to filing of the present application are that the respondent-husband has filed petition under section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act being registered as Family Suit No.35 of 2021 and the same is pending before the Court of learned Principal C/MCA/550/2023 ORDER DATED: 09/06/2023 Senior Civil Judge, Family Court at Bhavnagar.

Metropolitan Magistrate, Gandhinagar and also preferred Criminal Case No.1294 of 2021 before the Court of Vasani Alpanaben Vishalbhai vs Vasani Vishal Janakkumar on 9 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162528292/

sentences.text: learned 3rd Additional Senior Civil Judge, Gandhinagar under Section-498A of the IPC.
4. In these background of facts, the applicant herein has preferred the present application.
She is having no substantial income and it is difficult for her to attend the Court proceedings at Bhavnagar.
5. The law with respect to transfer of proceedings, particularly matrimonial disputes, is no longer res- integra.

Hon'ble Supreme Court in Sumitha Sing vs. Kumar Sanjay, [2002 KHC 1889], Mona Aresh Goel v. Aresh Satya Goel, [2000 KHC 1835], Vaishali Shridhar Jagtap vs. Shridhar Vishwanath Jagtap, [ 2016 KHC 6489], Santhini V. Vijaya Venkatesh, [2017 (5) KHC 48] and Asiwarya N.C.V. v. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha, [2022 (5) KHC 185 (SC)] held that it is the convenience of the woman and children that has to be looked into, while ordering the transfer of a case from one Court to another.

sentences.text:
6. In light of the law laid down in the aforementioned decisions, pleadings, the material on record and the C/MCA/550/2023 ORDER DATED: 09/06/2023 totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly, the inability of the applicant to travel and appear before the Court at Bhavnagar and to meet the expenses of travel, I am inclined to allow this application.
7.
Family Suit No.35 of 2021 is transferred from the Court of learned Principal Senior Civil Judge, Family Court at Bhavnagar to the Family Court at Gandhinagar.
Learned Family Court, Bhavnagar shall transmit the case record to the Family Court at Gandhinagar.
